From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@gridlytics.com>

Cc: priya.shah@gridlytics.com
Date: Fri, 15 Jul 2028 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Dedicated capacity demo request — throughput/latency focus

Hi Neha,

I just signed up via your self‑serve flow and selected the 'Dedicated' track for a demo. Gridlytics is evaluating options for a high‑throughput real‑time ingestion + low‑latency generation pipeline. Key constraints: sustained 150 QPS with 512 token context, p95 latency target < 200ms for single‑turn generation.

Can we schedule a 45‑60min technical demo that focuses on throughput sizing, latency tuning, and a short Q&A on quantization/kv cache behavior? Priya (cc'd) is our SRE lead — she will want to see specific test patterns. We're in ET (New York). Prefer the week of July 18; mornings are best for our team.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Lead ML Engineer | Gridlytics
liam.oconnor@gridlytics.com
+1 917‑555‑2419

Hi Liam — welcome, and thanks for the details. I'm Ben from Redwood SDR — I'll coordinate the scheduling.

We can do a 45‑minute technical walkthrough + 15 minutes for Q&A/next steps. Available slots (ET) the week of Jul 18:
- Tue 7/18 10:00–11:00

Hi Ben — thanks for the quick reply. Wed 7/19 09:30 ET works for us.

We'd prefer you focus first on the architecture + tuning and then talk through what a short live run would require (time, credentials, test data, network topology). Priya says she'd like to see the test harness you use and an example workload script. Also please include someone who can speak to autoscaling/burst behavior for reserved pools.

Two small asks:
- Can the session include a short mutual action plan or next steps doc we can sign off on?
- We're under a tight procurement timeline — if the demo looks good, we may ask for an architecture checklist + sample SOW outline.

Appreciate it — see you Wed.

Liam
